name: socialwifi__queue-messaging
root_api: marshmallow.Schema.dumps / Schema.loads, and Field.fail replaced by Field.make_error
behavioral_change: marshmallow v_old 2.16.3 to v_new 4.0.0 (v_old is a resolved value). Schema.dumps and Schema.loads no longer return a result object with .data and .errors (MarshalResult and UnmarshalResult) but return the data directly and raise on validation errors, and load now rejects unknown fields by default (unknown=RAISE) instead of ignoring them.
downstream_effect: The downstream serialization and deserialization paths fail at runtime under the new return-value and unknown-field semantics; the original tests need no change (empty test_patch).
reference_fix: The reference fix rewrites the serialization paths to the new semantics and passes unknown=EXCLUDE explicitly on deserialization, plus a minor change of self.fail() to raise self.make_error().

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
